title: The repaired shade
context: An original fictional visual vignette; no historical event is asserted.
drawing: Flat color animation with soft closed silhouettes. People have oversized rounded heads, compact solid trunks, and broad rounded arm and leg shapes that carry visible mass. Small paddle-shaped hands and blunt feet finish the silhouette. Two upright dark pill marks are the only facial marks: no mouth, nose, brows, pupils or eye shine. Clothing covers the body normally, with no anatomy visible through fabric. Read emotion from posture, head angle and pauses. Use quiet edges and limited shading; avoid glossy toy surfaces and mechanical additions.

cast.lead: Jun is an adult lantern maker with a warm brown rounded face, two dark upright pill eyes and black hair in a low knot secured by a plain wooden pin. She has a compact, fully filled figure, a dark jade cross-collar robe, a rust-colored apron, cream lower-leg wraps and rounded brown shoes. Her visible forearms and paddle-shaped hands are warm brown filled forms with clear width. No nose, mouth or eyebrows are drawn. Preserve the low knot, robe, apron and warm brown face.

props.item: One unlit pale-yellow paper lantern with a bamboo hoop and a curved bamboo handle.

exclude: Hairline arms or legs, empty ring heads, extra facial marks, cloned people or objects, anatomy showing through clothing, unrequested lettering, watermarks and brand marks.

shots.setting: A fictional riverside lantern workshop inspired broadly by pre-industrial Chinese craft spaces: timber walls, a low workbench, a lattice opening and muted green river light. The costume and room are illustrative reconstructions.

beats.action: A medium shot shows Jun at the workbench. She studies the lantern and reaches toward its handle.
Jun closes the right hand around the handle before lifting the lantern from the bench, keeping the left arm relaxed.
Jun holds the unlit lantern at chest height. Its paper sides stay intact; the robe conceals the body naturally.
